items.prompt: An apartment front door opened onto a stairwell landing on a Saturday afternoon: a composed woman of about forty in thin metal-framed glasses, dark hair in a low ponytail, holding a closed tablet against her chest, seen from inside the flat over the shoulder of a man.

alt.ru: Открытая дверь квартиры на лестничную площадку в субботу днём: собранная женщина лет сорока в тонких металлических очках, волосы в низком хвосте, прижимает к груди закрытый планшет.
alt.en: A flat's door open onto the landing on a Saturday afternoon: a composed woman of about forty in thin metal glasses, dark hair in a low ponytail, a closed tablet held to her chest.
alt.pt: A porta de um apartamento aberta para o patamar num sábado à tarde: uma mulher composta de uns quarenta anos com óculos finos de metal, cabelo escuro num rabo baixo, um tablet fechado contra o peito.
alt.es: La puerta de un piso abierta al rellano un sábado por la tarde: una mujer serena de unos cuarenta años con gafas finas de metal, pelo oscuro en una coleta baja, una tableta cerrada contra el pecho.

items.prompt: A kitchen doorway in a Moscow flat: a small child seen from behind stands in the doorway holding a big illustrated storybook against her side with one finger keeping the page; at the kitchen table beyond sit a man and a woman in glasses, both turned toward her.

alt.ru: Дверной проём кухни: маленькая девочка со спины стоит на пороге с большой книжкой сказок, заложив палец между страниц; за столом мужчина и женщина в очках повернулись к ней.
alt.en: A kitchen doorway: a small girl from behind stands holding a big storybook with a finger keeping the page; at the table a man and a woman in glasses turn toward her.
alt.pt: A porta de uma cozinha: uma menina pequena de costas segura um grande livro de contos com o dedo a marcar a página; à mesa um homem e uma mulher de óculos viram-se para ela.
alt.es: La puerta de una cocina: una niña pequeña de espaldas sostiene un gran libro de cuentos con un dedo marcando la página; a la mesa un hombre y una mujer con gafas se vuelven hacia ella.
